evolution.qualification: Uses only each period's claims and embeddings for its PCA, clustering and keywords. Centroid matches are descriptive similarities, not proof of emergence, disappearance, splits, merges, stance change, or causal change.
evolution.taxonomy: Independent discovery in each period; numeric IDs do not match across fits

fit.discovery_weighting: Weighted K-means gives equal group and within-group bundle mass; HDBSCAN is unweighted. Density coverage below 50% triggers the K-means candidate grid. Balanced refits diagnose sampling/initialization sensitivity.
fit.metric: Euclidean on unwhitened PCA; original cosine silhouette diagnostics
fit.selection: max(0, cosine silhouette) * coverage * (1-largest topic share) * min(cluster count/10, 1); fixed candidate-order tie break

limitations: Exploratory language subjects, not agreement or ideology. Pooled periods and genres differ; strict/expanded contrasts are source-composition sensitivity.

positions.qualification: Source-bound assistant synthesis of period- and document-diverse central examples, not independent human certification or an exhaustive stance classification. Statements describe the observed documents across years, not every member's beliefs or a current consensus.

taxonomy: Expanded-corpus shared assignments; strict shares use the same taxonomy

temporal.date_rule: Adoption date when recorded, otherwise publication date; preserve precision
temporal.relative_baseline: All other configured groups required; no changing vs-rest baselines
temporal.taxonomy: Fixed expanded-corpus topics; no per-period refits
temporal.weighting: Equal within-period document/fallback-bundle mass per organization
